name: Natsu no Iinchou
source:
It's the story of unrequited love for the class president, a girl who is always at the top of her class in both academics and sports and belongs to the rhythmic gymnastics club. My crush is the class president of the school. One afternoon after school, I save the class president from being assaulted by delinquents. And then... the class president and I transform into a lustful man and woman...

[Translated from [url=https://www.getchu.com/item/208421/]Getchu[/url]]
translation:
这是关于班长的单相思的故事，班长是一个在学业和体育上都名列前茅的女孩，属于艺术体操俱乐部。我的暗恋对象是学校的班长。一天下午放学后，我救了班长，使他免遭不良少年的袭击。然后……我和班长就变成了淫荡的男女……

[译自[url=https://www.getchu.com/item/208421/]Getchu[/url]]
